title: Apple Pre-Orders Kick Off With First Discounts on HomeView and Apple TV 4K
content:
Pre-orders are now live on Apple's newest devices, including the HomeView and Apple TV 4K, and Amazon has the first-ever discounts on these devices. We're also tracking great deals on MacBook Pro, Mac mini, and Apple Watch SE 3 in this week's best Apple deals.

Note: MacRumors is an affiliate partner with Amazon. When you click a link and make a purchase, we may receive a small payment, which helps us keep the site running.

Apple Pre-Orders



  • What's the deal? Get early pre-order discounts on HomeView, Apple TV 4K, and iPhone Duo

  • Where can I get it? Amazon and cellular carriers

  • Where can I find the original deal? Right here

$9 OFF
HomeView for $289.99

$9 OFF
Apple TV 4K for $289.99

UP TO $1,200 OFF
iPhone Duo at AT&T


It's pre-order week for Apple's newest devices, with the HomeView, Apple TV 4K, and iPhone Duo all now available to be pre-ordered. On Amazon, you can get a small discount on the HomeView and Apple TV 4K, while cellular carriers like AT&T have up to $1,200 off with trade-in credit on the iPhone Duo.

  • What's the deal? Get record low prices on Mac mini and Mac Studio

  • Where can I get it? Amazon

  • Where can I find the original deal? Right here

M5 Max Mac Studio 36GB/512GB for $2,299.00

$119 OFF
M6 Mac mini 16GB/256GB for $779.99

$149 OFF

Apple's M5 Max Mac Studio with 36GB RAM and a 512GB SSD is still on sale for $2,299.00, down from $2,499.00. Regarding the Mac mini, you can get the 16GB RAM/256GB SSD Mac mini for $779.99, down from $899.00, and the 16GB RAM/512GB SSD model for $949.99, down from $1,099.00.

Apple Watch SE 3

Apple Watch SE 3 (40mm GPS) for $199.99


Amazon is discounting one model of the Apple Watch SE 3 today, with a price that matches the Prime Day low we saw earlier in the month. You can get the 40mm GPS model for $199.99, a $49 discount.

Amazon has introduced a giant $800 discount on the 36GB/2TB 14-inch M5 Max MacBook Pro, now priced at $3,299.00. This is the steepest discount on the 14-inch models right now, but you'll also find a few entry-level options on sale below.
